summary: Policy template durations can be changed, and the records screens use plain names and clear buttons.

new.title: Change policy template durations
new.text: Each policy template now has editable maximum durations for activation, eligible and active assignments. Your next update asks you to confirm before rolling the change.

fixes.title: Records have plain names
fixes.text: Record types are now named for what they hold, such as Who gets which group or Administrator accounts.

fixes.title: An Edit button on every row
fixes.text: Edit is now the main row action and takes you straight to the first field.

fixes.title: Delete is now Stop managing
fixes.text: Removing a row never removed access, so the button now says Stop managing and points you to the way to actually remove access.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: The record search explains what it searches, the template rollout page uses plain words, and one menu entry is renamed to match its page.
